photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 17:33:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 1603 s; on-screen clock 04/13/13 17:33:50, wanted 17:33:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT13-102 17:33:30' on 2013-04-12 (`as run matrix!B97`), read as 2013-04-12 17:33. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-04-12 plus one day, 17:33: it was found 1553 s into this video, where the clock runs at about real speed (1.0 s per s); it is also found in 1 sped-up video(s), listed as further `video` rows. The fan setting on screen (42) is one the matrix's fan cell gives ('42', `as run matrix!J97`).
